reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing the operator's Butler mode popup and project list reports on live
reason: Live Butler mode showed 'Paged history requires include_replaced' when opening a chat's full transcript: ButlerChatPopup paged history without include_replaced, which Core requires (root cause independently validated). The popup now sends includeReplaced on both page reads and hides replaced messages like SessionsPage. The popup also overflowed the viewport because its auto grid track grew to the longest unbroken line; the track is now minmax(0, 860px) and errors wrap. The Projects rail listed ~1,000 projects; it is now one picker with active projects (counts) first and quiet ones grouped. Selected: a new ButlerChatPopup component test (paged calls carry includeReplaced, replaced messages hidden, older-page cursor), butlerThreads tests (new picker grouping helper), and the real-Core Butler mode journey (now asserts the transcript loads without an alert, the popup is inside and centred in the viewport, and picks a project thread through the picker) at desktop, compact and 390 px Chromium/WebKit, matching #1240's selection.
exclusions: No Core change, so no Python tests. The real-Core Playwright journey was not run locally; CI runs it. Other UI areas do not render the popup or the rail.
